name: chrome-agent-bridge
description: Connect AI harnesses and MCP agents to the user's existing Chrome session, with local browser and analysis tools.

interface.shortDescription: Let agents work through your existing Chrome session.
interface.longDescription: A local, open-source bridge that lets AI harnesses and MCP agents work through the Chrome browser the user already uses. It provides semantic page control, harness-connected sessions, sanitized monitoring, explicit Raw CDP, debugger and profiler workflows, and offline code, binary, protocol, and WASM analysis.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my current Chrome tab and summarize the page.
Monitor requests while I perform an action in Chrome.
Debug scripts on the approved tab and detach when finished.
Analyze this JavaScript or protocol payload locally.
